Util-kk

A small collection of general-purpose helpers for Koka — infix operators for string templating and combinators for working with std/text/parse.

go to toc: toc

Usage

module demo

import util

fun main() : console ()
  println("%name!"!^("%name", "World"))

Prints Hello, World!.

Installation

The flake exposes the library as packages.default, with resolved paths under kokaLibraries for downstream flakes:

nix build .packages.x86_64-linux.default

includePath=nix eval --raw .kokaLibraries.x86_64-linux.util.includePath

nix develop opens a shell that builds the library, puts it on the module search path, and writes koka.json, so the example above runs as-is.

Regenerating these docs

These pages are produced by the Koka compiler's --html backend plus the site scaffolding around it. To rebuild:

nix build .docs
# or, from a checkout:
scripts/build-docs.sh docs
